headline: Wildfire Resiliency goes before Board of Directors Meeting on Tuesday, October 20
blurb: The Telluride Fire Protection District board meets October 20th at 5:30 p.m. at Station 1 on Columbia Ave. Leading the agenda is the first reading of the 2027 budget — the opening move in a process that will play out over the next several weeks. The board will also ratify a pre-build contractor agreement with FCI, likely tied to the ongoing Station 3 update, and will receive a wildfire assignment update along with a September report on PANO camera usage.
